blocks.prompt: 15 (a) A locker of a bank is locked with four letters (A-Z). How many different passwords can be generated if: (a) repetition of the alphabets is allowed
blocks.explanation:
Password ek tarteeb wali string hai: ABCD aur DCBA do alag passwords hain, is liye order ki ahmiyat hai. Letters dobara aa sakte hain.
Find kya karna hai? 26 letters se 4-letter passwords ki tadaad.
Plan: 4 khaane, har khaane mein 26 choices: \(26^{4}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 26 letters (A se Z); 4 letters ka password; repetition (dohrana) allowed.
Humein find karna hai: passwords ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Fundamental principle of counting: 4 khaane ek ke baad ek bharein aur har khaane ki choices multiply karein. Yahan combination nahi lagta kyunke password mein tarteeb badalne se password badal jata hai.

Har khaane ki choices
\[26 \times 26 \times 26 \times 26\]
Kyun: Repetition allowed hai, yani A pehle khaane mein aa gaya to bhi doosre khaane mein A phir aa sakta hai. Is liye har khaane mein poore 26 letters available hain. Jaise AAAA bhi ek jaiz password hai.

Multiply karein
\[26^{2} = 676\]
\[26^{4} = 676 \times 676 = 456976\]
Kyun: \(26^{4} = (26^{2})^{2}\), is tarah do qadmon mein hisaab aasaan ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(26 \times 4 = 104\) likhna ghalat hai; har khaane ki choices zarb hoti hain, jama nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[676 \times 676 = 676 \times 700 - 676 \times 24\]
\[= 473200 - 16224 = 456976 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosre tareeqe se multiply karne par bhi wahi number aaya.

blocks.prompt: 15 (b) A locker of a bank is locked with four letters (A-Z). How many different passwords can be generated if: (b) repetition of the alphabets is not allowed
blocks.explanation:
Password hai, is liye order ki ahmiyat ab bhi hai, lekin ab charon letters mukhtalif hone chahiye.
Find kya karna hai? 26 letters mein se 4 ki tarteeb (arrangements).
Plan: \({}^{26}P_{4} = 26 \times 25 \times 24 \times 23\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 26 letters; 4-letter password; koi letter dobara nahi.
Humein find karna hai: passwords ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Tarteeb ahem hai aur repetition nahi, is liye yeh permutation \({}^{n}P_{r}\) hai, \(n = 26\), \(r = 4\). Combination nahi kyunke ABCD aur BACD alag locker kholte hain.

Khaana ba khaana choices
\[26 \times 25 \times 24 \times 23\]
Kyun: Pehle khaane mein 26 letters. Jo letter use ho gaya woh dobara nahi aa sakta, is liye doosre khaane mein 25, teesre mein 24, chauthe mein 23.

Multiply karein
\[26 \times 25 = 650\]
\[650 \times 24 = 15600\]
\[15600 \times 23 = 358800\]
Kyun: Do do numbers multiply kiye taake har qadam check ho sake.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{26}P_{4} = \dfrac{26!}{22!} = 26 \cdot 25 \cdot 24 \cdot 23\]
\[358800 < 456976 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula se bhi wahi product banta hai. Aur repetition band karne se passwords kam hone chahiye the, aur kam hi hue (part (a) se chhota number).
Dhyan dein: \({}^{26}C_{4} = 14950\) yahan ghalat hai; woh letters ka sirf group ginta hai, un ki tarteeb nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (i) 358,800 aur (ii) 14,950 likhti hai. 358,800 part (b) ka jawab hai, (a) ka nahi; 14,950 \(= {}^{26}C_{4}\) combination hai, jo password ke liye ghalat hai kyunke letters ki tarteeb ahem hai. Sahi jawab: (a) \(26^{4} = 456{,}976\); (b) \({}^{26}P_{4} = 358{,}800\).
